label: T-Mobile KVD21
description: T-Mobile 5G Gateway built by Arcadyan (KVD21), the small-business and home fixed-wireless CPE with a front LCD for signal bars, connected-device count and messages, fed by four internal wideband OMNI antennas covering the full LTE/5G band set. Wired connectivity is two RJ45 LAN ports labelled LAN1 and LAN2, and the radios are simultaneous dual-band Wi-Fi 6 with 4x4 MIMO plus the 5G NR uplink itself.
notes: T-Mobile tech specs: 'Dual Band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) with 4x4MIMO', 'WPA2/WPA3 Wi-Fi Security', 'Ethernet plugs 2xRJ-45', 'Maximum recommended devices: 64', AC adapter 12 V/1.2 A. User guide: 'The gateway has two (2) Ethernet LAN ports', referred to as LAN1 and LAN2, and 'the gateway offers 4G/LTE or 5G/NR WAN mobile network connectivity by way of four wide band OMNI antennas'. Caveat recorded honestly: T-Mobile publishes the port count but not the line rate, so each jack is modelled at 1 GbE - consistent with the 1 Gbps service cap - and wwan0 at 1G is the same cap. No WAN Ethernet port exists (cellular is the only uplink); there is no bridge mode, so a lab sees double NAT when chaining a router behind it.
